text:
We went today to the office in Tel Aviv to reschedule the A5 interview we were supposed to have back then in March before it was canceled because of the War. We also sent an email requesting to reschedule 4 weeks ago and of course they didn't respond. When asking them today why they didn't respond, they said they still reply to mails from more than 2 months ago. 

Long story short - don't wait for them to reply to your mails. I strongly advice you to go there physically for whatever it is you need.
